subject: Quick thought on the Buckeye Dental Care website
body: Hi Buckeye Dental Care team, I came across your practice while looking into dental providers in Amelia, OH, and wanted to reach out. It is great to see how comprehensive your services are, especially your focus on gentle care for patients with dental anxiety and specialized options like implants and root canals. While browsing your current site at buckeyedentalcare.net, I noticed that adding a direct online booking button and highlighting your accepted insurance providers right in the header could make it much easier for busy families to schedule visits. To show how this might look, I put together a modern, fast-loading prototype for your practice. Feel free to check out the live preview here: https://812fb2fc.nayom-biz-0x884107a49bdb2ebb-0x.pages.dev. If you would like to use this design or have me tweak anything, I would be happy to send over the project files or chat for 5 minutes. No worries at all if you are happy with your current setup!
key_improvements: Added a prominent Book Appointment button to the main header
Displayed insurance provider logos to reinforce most insurances accepted claim
